content: Amasías, Judá-yar sesad
Joacaz-machi-Joás, birgabogus Israelʼgi-negsemaidgi, Joás-machi-Amasías, Judá-yar sealid.
Amasías birga-dulagwen-gakatar-nikadgi (25) yar sealid. Jerusalénʼgi birga-dulagwen-gakabakebak (29) yar sesad. E-nandi Joadánʼye-nugad, Jerusalénʼginedid.
Amasías, Bab-Dummad-asabin bela ibmar-nueganbi imaksad. Degi-inigwele, e-dad-dummad-David ibmar-imaksadyob imaksasulid. Ar ade, e-bab-Joás-ibmar-imaksayobi, ibmar-imaksamogad.
Amasías, bab-dummad-baidse-goled-aila-matusurmalad osulossulid, aga dulemar ibmar-ogumakleged, degi, ina-wawadikmalad, e-bab-dummadga-ibmar-ogumakleged-ailagi amba ukdii damalad.
Amasías nue-yar-sealidgi, dule-nuga-nikamalad e-bab-oburgwisgusmalad bela ogilosad.

Degi-inigwele, e-bab-oburgwismalad-e-mimmigandi ogilossulid. Ar ade, Bab-Jehová Moisés-Igar-Maidgi weyob igar-uksad: “Babgan e-mimmigan-ular burgosulid. E-mimmiganmoga e-babgan-ular burgosurmogad. Ar na e-isgusadba na dukin-dukin burgwemaloed.”
Amasías, Balu-Nebagi miliambe (10,000) Edom-dulemar-ogilosad, degi, Sela-neggwebur susad. Geb a-neggwebur Jocteelʼye nug-imaksad. Emi, we-garda-narmaklenaidse amba deyob nugad.
Ibagwengi, Amasías, Israel-e-rey-Joásʼse gayaburba-berbemalad barmisad. Joásʼde, Joacaz-e-machid, Jehú-wagwad. Weyob Amasías ega gayaburba-barmisad: “Anmar anbo-urwemalaga be dago.”

Geb Israel-e-rey-Joásʼdi, weyob Judá-rey-Amasías-abin-imaksad: “Ibagwengi, Líbano-yargi gagan-ikobiid-gwichid urwar-gwichidse gayaburba barmisad. Weyob ega sogsiid: ‘An-machiga be-sisgwa, be uke, na nikuega.’ Geb agi, Líbano-yalagi ibmar-durgan-ursilimalad-bukwad ainiargu, gagan-ikobiidgi bela annasmalad.
Ar be Edom-dulemargi be nakwisad, degi, abali be yeer-itoged. Degisoggu, be san-dummarba imake, degi, bur neggi-meremai be sae. ¿Ibiga, na be dukin, Judá-yarga naibid amibisunna?”
Degi-inigwele, Amasías, Joásʼba ibsassulid. Degisoggu, Joás, Bet-Semes-neggwebursik nadsunnad, Bet-Semesʼde Judá-yar-abargi-siid. Adi, agi Judá-e-reygi bila-onogega.
Judá-sordamar, Israel-sordamarse galakusad, bela e-neg-e-negse wakite duurmakdemalad.

Israel-rey-Joás, Bet-Semesʼgi Rey-Amasías-gasad. Amasíasʼde, Joás-e-machid, Ocozías-wagwad. Agine, Joás Jerusalénʼse naded, geb dali-dulatar-wilub (100) yawagak-Efraínʼye-nugad-akale, degi, Yawagak-Dikarye-nugadse galu-matusulid earisad.
Deginbali, Joás we-ibmar susbalid:
Geb Samaria-neggweburse gannar nonigusad.
Joás ibmar-baigan-imaksadi, degi, e-gangued-oyosadi, degine, Judá-rey-Amasíasʼgi bila-onosadi, Israel-e-reymar-ibmar-imaksad-gardagi narmakar maid.
Israel-e-rey-Joás burgwisgu, Samaria-neggweburgi reymar-abargi diglesad. A-sorbali, e-machi-Jeroboam yar sesad.
Joacaz-e-machi-Joás-burgwisad-sorbali, Judá-e-rey-Amasías birgambe-gakatar (15) amba reyga-maigusad.
Amasías ibmar-baigan-imaksadi, Judá-e-reymar-ibmar-imaksad-gardagi narmakar maid.

Dulemar Jerusalén-neggweburgi Amasíasʼgi gwisguega igar amismalad. Geb degi, Amasíasʼdi, Laquis-neggweburse wakite gusad. Degi-inigwele, dulemar Laquis-neggweburse balimaksagusad, agine oburgwismalad.
Geb David-neggweburse Jerusalénʼse moligi searmalad. Geb e-babgan-abargi digsamalad.
Geb a-sorbali, Judá-dulemar, Azarías reyga omesismalad, adi, e-bab-Amasías-sorba yar-seegar. Deunni Azarías birgambe-gakanergwa (16) nikad.
Azarías, e-bab-burgwisad-sorba, Elat-neggwebur gannar-nudaksad, geb, Judá-dulemarga gannar uknonikid.
Jeroboam-baid, Israel-yar sesad
Joás-machi-Amasías, birgambe-gakatargus (15) Judá-yargi negsemaidgi, Joás-machi-Jeroboam, Israel-yar sealid. Samariaʼgi birga-dulabo-gakagwensak (41) yar sesad.
Jeroboam, Bab-Jehová-ibmar-abemaisulidi imaksad. Ar ade, Nabat-machi-Jeroboam Israel-dulemar-oichogega-imaksagusadgi gwen bangussulid.

Jeroboam Israel-yar-abingunaid gannar Hamat-neggwebur-doglemaid-akale, Arabá-demar-nomaidse omesnonikid. Ar igi Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová e-gayaburba-barsoged-Jonásʼba ibmar sogsagusa, deyob gusad. Jonásʼde, Amitai-e-machid, Gat-Hefer-neggweburginedid.
Ar Bab-Jehová, bela Israel-neggweburgi dulemar-gudidimalad, maiga-gudimalad, maiga-gudisurmalad, nue-wilebukwa daksad, dule gwen Israel-neggwebur-bendaked-nikasuli daksad.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová, Joás-machi-Jeroboamʼba Israel-dulemar-bendaksad. Ar ade, Bab-Jehová sogsagusad: “Napneggi Israel-nuga an osulogosurye.”

Bela Jeroboam e-ibmar-imaksadi, degi, ibmar-baigan-imaksadi, degine, e-gangued-oyosadi, deginbali, bila-onosadgi Damasco-neggwebur, degi, Hamat-neggwebur gannar Judá-neggweburga susgusadi, Israel-e-reymar-ibmar-imaksad-gardagi narmakar maid.
Degi, Jeroboam burgwisad. E-dadgan-Israel-e-reyga-megismalad-abargi diglesad. A-sorbali, e-machi-Zacarías yar sesad.
